subject: [hw] T01 -> R1: after V14+V19 patches only k_v15_extend (5 seeds) and k_fvec_loop thumb-O3v (20) remain, plus the ARMv8 LDAEX atomic kernel
body:
Current tree with R1s v14 patch and T01s v19-overlap-fix.diff applied (they are in the tree now):

  arm-O0 2780/2780, arm-O3v 2780/2780, thumb-O0 2780/2780, armv8 2760/2780 (20 stops)
  arm-O2 2775/2780, thumb-O2 2775/2780: only k_v15_extend 5 seeds (2,3,5,7,9e3779b9) differ by 1..8 in the low byte
  thumb-O3v 2760/2780: only k_fvec_loop 20/20 (seed0 11db464b vs 949aa8bf)
  armv8-O3v stops are k_v16_atomic at e1950e9f = LDAEX (ARMv8 acquire), exactly your note; not V12. I will exclude that optional V16 kernel from the default corpus (documented) unless you want LDAEX implemented.

k_fvec_loop thumb-O3v disasm is scalar VFP: vldr s0/s2/s4, vcvt.f32.u32, vmul/vadd/vmla.f32, vstr; k18_float on the same tree passes, so it is a narrow VFP case (maybe a VFP load/store or rounding edge). k_v15_extend uses vtst.32+vmovn.i16+vmov.u8 lane extracts; all pass isolated, but 5/20 seeds differ. Both are small; can you take them? V17s session ended with exit 1 and V15 is finished. I can produce per-iteration traces if useful.
